title: Proposed Amendments to City of Silverton Municipal Charter
ballot_label: Proposed Amendments to City of Silverton Municipal Charter. Question: Shall the legal voters of the City of Silverton approve the proposed amendments to the municipal charter?
summary: Asks Silverton voters to amend the city charter, last amended in 1985. According to the ballot summary, the amendments would remove or amend sections that may not comply with or unnecessarily duplicate state law, clarify certain City Council rights, duties and procedures, and clarify certain city manager responsibilities. The explanatory statement says some sections, including the section titled Mayor, would be repealed and others added. Amendments would take effect January 1, 2027.
yes_means: A yes vote approves the proposed amendments to the City of Silverton charter, effective January 1, 2027.
no_means: A no vote rejects the proposed amendments, leaving the current Silverton charter (last amended in 1985) unchanged.

arguments.author: City of Silverton (official ballot title summary)
arguments.statement: The official ballot summary, prepared by the City of Silverton, says many current charter provisions are outdated and hinder effective and efficient city operations.
arguments.excerpt: Many current charter provisions are outdated and hinder effective and efficient municipal operations.

collection_notes: yes_means/no_means: Oregon local ballot titles carry no official result-of-vote text, so these are neutral one-sentence descriptions written by the collector, grounded strictly in the official ballot question/summary. Arguments of kind 'explainer' on the YES side quote the rationale that the official ballot title/explanatory statement attributes to the sponsoring governing body; they are not filed pamphlet arguments. No comparable NO-side statement exists in the official text. Search budget: the shared WebSearch budget for this run was exhausted partway through step 3; the measure-number search was run for both sides, but the T3 allowed-domain search could not be run for either side. Equal effort was kept: the same searches ran for YES and NO. City Resolution No. 26-28 (adopted Aug 5, 2026; https://www.silverton.or.us/media/20676) refers the amendments; the ballot summary itself cites the charter markup at https://www.silverton.or.us/media/20201 (title 'FINAL APPROVED CHARTER CHANGES - MARKUP'). Inventory title matches the caption.
